homeConfig.content:
[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/crates-acme-test/"

[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]

[source.spindrift-upstream-private]
registry = "sparse+https://crates.acme.test/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/crates-acme-test/"

[source.spindrift-upstream-other-private]
registry = "sparse+https://other.acme.test/idx/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy-other-acme-test-other-private"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy-other-acme-test-other-private]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/other-acme-test/idx/"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy-other-acme-test-other-private]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/other-acme-test/idx/"
